title: Archaeological retrieval of craft from the ocean floor

tellings.quote: If you're digging something up under, you know, tens of meters of of sediment deposited on the ocean floor, like that takes time to build up.

plain: Matthew Brown, a man presented on a podcast as a Pentagon whistleblower, talks about pulling craft up from the ocean floor as if it were an archaeological dig. Speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, he says that anything buried under tens of meters of seabed sediment must have been there a very long time, because that much sediment takes ages to build up. If true, it would mean such craft have been on Earth for a very long time.
